_doc: Personal crafting at furniture stations (player/crafting.js). Each recipe: station (cook|craft|smelt|brew|tan|arms — the Weaponsmith & Armoury at an anvil: the weapons, shields, helms and harness of data/arms.json), skill (the craft skill it trains and leans on: data/craftGrades.json skills; default by station), ingredients, result, difficulty 1-5, xp, quality (false = an intermediate that comes out Common), smith (true = worked at the Forge minigame), attr (the attribute that steadies the hand). The grade of the work (Poor to Masterwork, data/craftGrades.json) is rolled from the skill, the workshop, tools, the inputs' grade, the forge and the seeded RNG; ranks (config.ranks) count all crafting xp.

config._tuning: The grade roll lives in data/craftGrades.json (roll). Failure here: base + difficulty x perDifficulty - skill level x perLevel - workshop - tools (+ the forge), clamped to [min, max].
